entity_id.description: Internal unique identifier for the entity record, assigned by the platform.

case_id.description: Case management system reference number for this KYC review case.

cip_classification.description: Customer Identification Program (CIP) classification assigned under US BSA/AML requirements.

commodities_future_trading_commission_re.description: Indicates whether the entity is registered with the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).

country_of_incorporation.description: Country in which the entity was legally incorporated or formed.

registration_country.description: Country in which the entity is registered with the relevant commercial/company registry; must equal the country of organization.

date_of_incorporation.description: Date on which the entity was officially incorporated or registered.

legal_structure.description: Legal structure of the entity (e.g. Corporation, LLC, Limited Partnership, Trust).

entity_giin.description: Global Intermediary Identification Number (GIIN) assigned under FATCA for reporting purposes.

entity_name.description: Official legal name of the entity as registered with the relevant authority.

entity_nature_of_business.description: Description of the entity's primary business activities.

activity_type.description: Classification of the entity's primary type of business activity.

entity_risk_rating.description: KYC risk classification assigned to the entity based on the risk assessment framework.

entity_status.description: Current registration status of the entity (e.g. Active, Dissolved, In Liquidation).

legal_registered_address.description: Official registered address used for legal notices and regulatory correspondence.

lei_code.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) â€” 20-character ISO 17442 code assigned by an accredited LOU.

listed_exchange.description: Name of the stock exchange on which the entity is listed, if applicable.

listing_status.description: Indicates whether the entity's shares or units are publicly listed on a recognised stock exchange.

other_business_activity.description: Any secondary or ancillary business activities conducted by the entity.

parent_publicly_listed_on_united_states_.description: Indicates whether the entity's ultimate parent is publicly listed on a US stock exchange.

previous_names.description: Historical legal names or trading names formerly used by the entity.

principal_place_of_business.description: Primary address from which the entity conducts its day-to-day business operations.

regulator.description: Primary regulatory authority or authorities supervising the entity's licensed activities.

securities_exchange_act_of_1934_section_.description: Indicates whether the entity is a reporting company under Section 13 or 15(d) of the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934.

sole_proprietorship_indicator.description: Indicates whether the entity is operated as a sole proprietorship with no separate legal personality.

source_of_funds.description: Identifies the origin of funds used in the entity's business activities.

source_of_wealth.description: Describes how the entity's net worth or investable assets were accumulated.

sub_advisor.sub_advisor_name.description: Legal name of any sub-advisor appointed to act on behalf of or alongside the entity.

sub_advisor.sub_advisor_address.description: Registered or operational address of the sub-advisor.

trading_names.description: Any trading or doing-business-as (DBA) names used by the entity.

transacting_with_own_or_third_party_fund.description: Indicates whether the entity transacts using its own funds, third-party client funds, or both.

tax_identification_number.description: Entity tax identification number. Multi-value; jurisdiction is conveyed by lineage source.

registration_number.description: Entity registration number issued by the relevant company/registry authority. Multi-value; jurisdiction is conveyed by lineage source.

verification_of_existence.description: Confirms that the entity's legal existence has been independently verified against an official registry or source.

website_address.description: Official website URL of the entity.

wbq_flag.description: Indicates whether the client has provided a Wolfsberg Questionnaire (WBQ).

public_accounting_firm_indicator.description: Indicates whether the entity is a public accounting firm.

fca_firm_reference_number.description: UK FCA Firm Reference Number (FRN) identifying the regulated firm.

documents.document_certification_indicat.description: Indicates whether the document has been certified or notarised by a recognised authority.

documents.document_date.description: The date shown on the document (e.g. signing date, filing date).

documents.document_date_of_expiration.description: The date on which the document expires and is no longer considered valid.

documents.document_date_of_issue.description: The date on which the document was officially issued.

documents.document_name.description: File name or descriptive title of the document as received or stored.

documents.document_type.description: Specific type of the document (e.g. Certificate of Incorporation, Passport, Board Resolution).

documents.document_category.description: High-level category grouping for the document (e.g. Formation Document, Financials, Individual Identification).

documents.document_accession_number.description: SEC EDGAR accession number identifying the specific filing.

acting_person.acting_person_name.description: Full legal name of the individual acting on behalf of the entity.
